selection_basis: PRE_REGISTRATION.md rule: lowest dev pooled log loss on common set (n=3437); no simpler model within CI (it has 0 fitted parameters, the minimum).
estimator_definition: Solve lambda_home, lambda_away by least squares so independent-Poisson P(home), P(away), P(over2.5) match the CLOSING de-vigged 1X2 consensus and closing OU2.5 source-average probability (1X2 only if OU2.5 missing); P(BTTS YES) = (1-exp(-lh))(1-exp(-la)). No recalibration.
calibration_procedure: none (raw). market_implied_poisson_recal is reported but not selected.

reliability_filters_to_test.name: exclude_E1_high_prob_picks
reliability_filters_to_test.rationale: Dev error analysis: E1 >=60% picks 56.3% correct (n=48) vs E0 71.2% (n=139); CIs overlap, so this is a hypothesis only. Accept only if holdout shows the same direction AND the kept-set accuracy stays calibrated.
